FC-7B.title: Figure C-7B: Direct Shear Test Data - Shear Stress vs. Shear Displacement (printed C-22, PDF 136)
FC-7B.legend_hint: see the notes on this figure
FC-7B.notes_for_reviewers: Printed sideways: horizontal load (psi) against horizontal motion (inches), RSM-b at Dr 1.0, six tests 3.4 to 27.1 psi, symbols only. Close-ups are shown upright. The legend prints only the stresses, each beside the end of its curve; symbols: quarter-circle 27.1, star 13.8, triangle 10.2, diamond 6.6, square 5.1, circle 3.4 psi. Near the origin many symbols overlap.
